text:
eve_peopleops: Quick check before I publish the Q2 review schedule tomorrow AM. Two new items to confirm: (1) proxy voting for managers who will be traveling, (2) an anonymized calibration option to reduce bias. Reply with a one-liner if you approve or have a contra. :wave:

marco_hr: Proxy voting OK. Managers must add a proxy name in the "Proxy" column on the calibration sheet and DM HR to approve. Proxy must be a peer manager (no direct reports). Anonymized calibration: leads will publish redacted summaries first; full comments unmasked only if needed.

eng-manager-nina: Sounds fine. Question: will proxies be able to see full manager comments or only vote?

calib-lead-hassan: Proxies get view+vote, but they should not edit the manager's original comment. We'll enforce by using view-only links for manager comments and a separate vote column. During the meeting we use the redacted view; unmasking controlled by leads.

peopleops-bot: Heads-up: tentative deadlines for the cycle posted in the draft doc. Reminder: calibrations start Mon 2026-04-20; ensure proxies are assigned by Fri 2026-04-17 17:00 PDT.

marco_hr: Publishing the formal checklist in the doc. Short copy for managers to forward: "Please include 3 outcomes with metrics where possible, 1 example of cross-team impact, 1 development goal, and 1 artifact link. Keep self-assessments ~150-300 words."

calib-lead-hassan: Timelines I will put in the calendar invite:
```
- Self-assessments due: 2026-04-11 23:59 PDT
- Grace window (for documented travel/launch conflicts): until 2026-04-13 18:00 PDT (manager note required)
- Manager comments due: 2026-04-14 16:00 PDT
- Final uploads to /Shared/Reviews/2026-Q2 by: 2026-04-15 12:00 PDT
- Calibration meetings: week of 2026-04-20
```

eve_peopleops: Thanks all 5D I'll add proxy + anonymized flow to the announcement and the review doc. Managers: if you plan to delegate, please add your proxy in the sheet and DM HR by EOD Fri. Posting final timeline in #announcements tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
